project_context: Benchmark corpus for OASE-like academic IR prototype. This corpus is NOT the actual OASE Udayana corpus. It is a publicly accessible representative corpus used to develop and evaluate the IR system prototype.
target_use_case: Universitas Udayana OASE — academic document discovery for students and lecturers
prototype_corpus: Publicly accessible academic sources listed below
disclaimer: This system does not claim to index OASE Udayana documents. OASE documents are not publicly accessible and cannot be crawled without authorized access.

sources.license: Creative Commons (varies per course — check individual course pages)
faculties_covered: Fakultas Ilmu Sosial dan Ilmu Politik (FISIP)
sources.note: Used as lecture material benchmark corpus. Materials are publicly accessible via OCW UI portal without authentication.

sources.license: arXiv non-exclusive license to distribute (see https://arxiv.org/help/license)
sources.note: Research preprints collected via official arXiv API. Computer Science and AI/ML domains.
Open access research papers aggregated from multiple institutional repositories.
Open access journal articles from DOAJ-indexed publications.
Thesis and dissertation documents from publicly accessible institutional repositories.

ethical_notes: Only publicly accessible documents without authentication requirements are indexed.
Documents requiring login, institutional access, or payment are excluded.
OASE Udayana documents are NOT indexed — they require institutional authentication.
robots.txt and rate limits were respected during data collection.
SHA-256 deduplication prevents double-indexing of identical files.
